name: po11_19_store_framing
description: Section 11 test 19. In a save with N props the record (0x2977AA47, 0x299B2D1B, 0) parses into exactly N entries with no trailing bytes, and each entry's CRC verifies under CRC-32/MPEG-2 over min(entrySize - 8, 250000) bytes from the object ID (foundations 3.3-3.4).
